title: Settings control room
lede: Settings is now a searchable control room: icon rail, Booking vs Schedule, matching titles, related jumps, and stable save bars.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Matched Cursor IDE Chromium captures at 1372×1160 CSS pixels (PNGs 2744×2320), ADMIN, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000. Parallel page-chrome work is also visible in the global sidebar (account at the bottom, Notifications no longer in the rail). Settings-specific change is the inner control room.

pairs.title: Overview
pairs.beforeCap: Choose a settings area. Sports lived under People. Checkout policies sat in Inventory. Reservation, calendars, locations, and overdue lived together as Scheduling. No in-page filter.
pairs.afterCap: Searchable directory with Resume. Booking and Schedule are separate groups. Sports moved under Schedule. Icon tiles plus an icon rail.

pairs.title: Appearance
pairs.beforeCap: Theme and text size with a text rail and no related-page jump.
pairs.afterCap: Same picker, icon rail, matching title, and a Related link to Notifications.

sections.heading: After only
sections.note: The Profile baseline landed on the loading skeleton, so it is not a trustworthy loaded-form comparison. Sports, Checkout policies, Notifications, and overview filter had no matched before.

shots.title: Overview filter
shots.cap: Typing kiosk reduces the directory to Kiosks. Resume stays available.

shots.title: Profile
shots.cap: Loaded form with Slack handle, stable Saved bar, and Related jumps to Security and Notifications.

shots.title: Notifications
shots.cap: Quiet hours, delivery channels, and type rows with related Appearance.

shots.title: Sports
shots.cap: Schedule-group tab with on-page jump nav for Auto assign, Non-game, and Sports.

shots.title: Checkout policies
shots.cap: Booking-group loan rules with a stable save bar and related Reservation, Overdue, and Extensions links.

changes.h: Settings is a directory, not a dump of tabs
changes.was: Overview listed every page in mixed People / Inventory / Scheduling groups. Finding Kiosks or overdue meant scanning the rail.
changes.now: In-page filter plus Resume. Booking and Schedule are separate jobs. Sports sits with calendars and locations.

changes.was: Titles drifted from nav labels. Long pages had no jump. Related work lived in other groups with no cross-links.
changes.now: Titles come from SETTINGS_SECTIONS. Related links sit under every tab. Sports and Security get on-page jump nav.

changes.h: Saves and empty states say what they mean
changes.was: Some forms swapped button labels while saving. Profile omitted Slack. Collaborator empty/dirty states were easy to misread.
changes.now: Shared save bars keep Saved / Save changes / Saving stable. Profile writes slackHandle. Empty and dirty states stay explicit.

verification: Authenticated Preview as Erik Role ADMIN at http://127.0.0.1:3000. Overview filter, Profile loaded form, Appearance, Notifications, Sports jump nav, and Checkout policies dirty/reset save bar were exercised in the Cursor browser.
npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false and npm run lint run after the review page.
npm run build:app was not run because Preview next dev already owns port 3000.
notes: Route URLs and role gates did not change. App activity remains owner-only and off the default rail.
Profile first paint is still slow enough that a snapshot can land on skeletons; wait for the form before judging the page.
The Settings directory filter and the global ⌘K palette are separate. A leftover palette from a prior shortcut can sit over the overview until Escape.
Parallel uncommitted page-chrome work is visible in these captures and was preserved.
